## Applied Data Products

```{=html}
<div class="course-list">

  <a href="https://deonroos.shinyapps.io/Aberdeen_House_Prices/" class="explainer-card" target="_blank">
    <div class="explainer-card-img-wrap">
      <img src="media/house_price.png" class="explainer-card-img" alt="">
    </div>
    <div class="explainer-card-content">
      <div class="explainer-card-title">Predicting House Prices</div>
      <p class="explainer-card-desc">A production Shiny application backed by an automated data pipeline. Property listings are scraped on a scheduled basis, cleaned, and stored in a SQLite database. The application serves live predictions from a fitted regression model without re-querying the source on demand. Built to give students a locally relevant end-to-end modelling example, from raw data ingestion through to a live interactive front-end.</p>
    </div>
  </a>

</div>
```
